description: Check status of a queued music job. Returns JSON progress while PROCESSING. Completed jobs are either an embedded base64 audio MCP resource or a download_url resource link. POST endpoint with body {model, queue_id}. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

delete_media_on_completion.description: Delete server-side media after embedded audio has been buffered, before the tool result returns to the client. Ignored for download_url results: download first, then call venice_music_complete.

name: venice_music_status
title: Venice Music Retrieve / Status
